root_cause: main.py, core/database.py and services/llm_provider.py call load_dotenv() at import time. pytest_configure runs BEFORE those imports, so variables it clears are re-SET from the project .env when the app is imported (load_dotenv sets keys absent from the environment). Test outcomes therefore depended on the developer's .env file.
fix: backend/tests/conftest.py disables dotenv.load_dotenv for the test process only. Runtime semantics are untouched: Docker/production still use env_file: .env and the real load_dotenv().
fix_level: test fixture (conftest), not a command-line pin
